summary: New Oriental Education & Technology Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Annual Report for the fiscal year ended May 31, 2026, published under the Hong Kong Stock Exchange listing rules; the equivalent US filing is an annual report on Form 20-F. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is a routine annual reporting obligation by a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation mechanics, overhang, or regulatory clock; there is no deal-term or risk-arbitrage angle to monitor.
